description: The whole MRR Ledger dataset in one call. format "csv" ($0.25 USDC via x402): every sourced revenue figure for every business, superseded ones included (one row per figure, 14 columns, source_url on each). format "jsonl" ($0.50): one full business record per line. Optional slug = one business, same price. Included with Builder (csv) and Team (csv + jsonl) API keys. Call without payment for a free preview (real sample rows) plus the x402 terms, then retry with params._meta["x402/payment"] (x402 v2 or v1 payload).
name: export_dataset
title: Export the full dataset (x402)
